author: zigagrcar
name: cryptoprices
description: Look up cryptocurrency prices and historical charts from CoinGecko, and check the Fear & Greed Index from alternative.me, with in-memory caching to avoid rate limits.
short: Cryptocurrency prices, charts, and Fear & Greed Index via CoinGecko.
install_msg: Thanks for installing CryptoPrices! Use `[p]crypto <coin> [currency]` to get started, or `[p]help CryptoPrices` for all available commands.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store data about users.
